title: Broadcasting: the rule, and the errors it produces

videos.script: Subtract one number from a whole table. It works, and nobody asks why. {{number}} Subtract a row of seven numbers from a table of fifty-two weeks. That works too. {{row}} Subtract a column of fifty-two weekly means, and you get an error. {{error}} One rule decides all three. Line the shapes up from the right. A length of one stretches. Anything else must match. {{rule}} This lesson reads that rule into every error message, and fixes each one with a single extra axis. {{axis}} Then it shows the case the rule allows and you did not mean. A forecast of seven days, compared with seven days, gives forty-nine comparisons. {{silent}} No error. A number at the end that looks fine. {{fine}} And last, the same trick used on purpose, to build every pair at once. {{end}}
